proposed.explanation: The investor has a short time horizon of 3 months to raise 10,000 EGP for a family wedding, with low risk tolerance and low ability to absorb financial losses. Selling all 200 shares of EFID at the current market price of 20.40 EGP per share generates 4,080.00 EGP. Added to the existing cash of 1,000.00 EGP, total cash reserves will increase to 5,080.00 EGP, eliminating short-term equity market volatility risk. Although EFID demonstrates strong financial fundamentals—with 2025 consolidated revenue reaching 20915072432 EGP compared to 16146545699 EGP in 2024, net profit rising to 2695301670 EGP from 1606727698 EGP in 2024, and EPS increasing to 2.18 EGP from 1.09 EGP in 2024—equity price uncertainty over 3 months makes holding stock risky for immediate cash needs. Note that even after liquidating the entire EFID holding, total portfolio cash (5,080.00 EGP) falls short of the target 10,000 EGP by 4,920.00 EGP, requiring external funding sources.
